rule.escalation: each consecutive keep moves the cost one more round earlier than the last: -1, then -2, then -3 (JSN: round 10 -> 9 -> 7 -> 4)
rule.undrafted_note: an undrafted player's first keep costs round 17, then escalates the same way (Irving: 17 -> 15)
rule.floor_note: Nacua (round 2 kept in 2025, round 1 in 2026) suggests a cost can't go earlier than round 1. Set false if a player whose cost passes round 1 can no longer be kept.
rule.cost_follows_player: traded and dropped players keep their original draft cost
